create.name: Larissa Hall Carlson
create.bio:
Larissa Hall Carlson has taught yoga for close to thirty years, most of them in connection with Kripalu Center in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, where she was once dean of the School of Ayurveda and now directs 200-hour, 500-hour and advanced teacher trainings. She holds a master's degree in mindfulness studies and is a certified Ayurvedic practitioner, and she has also trained as an end-of-life doula and in Yee Yoga and prenatal yoga. With Dr. John Douillard she co-led the Ayurveda 101 and 201 online courses for Yoga Journal.

Her teaching brings together breathwork, meditation and seasonal Ayurvedic self-care, with a particular love of pranayama and of the four heart practices of loving-kindness, compassion, joy and equanimity. For more than ten years she worked with the young musicians at Tanglewood, and she has taught at conservatories, schools and universities, helping performers find steadiness before they go on stage. She leads retreats at Kripalu, Canyon Ranch and the Sivananda Ashram in the Bahamas, gives Vedic astrology readings and Ayurveda consultations over Zoom, sells short audio courses through her own site and shares a library of free guided practices on Insight Timer. Her business, Vermont Vedic Arts, is based in southern Vermont.

courses.title: Begin Again: A New Year Mindfulness Retreat for a Fresh Start
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu in the Berkshires to open the year with meditation, gentle movement and time for reflection. Larissa guides you in setting intentions and settling into a calmer pace before the months ahead.

courses.title: The Boundless Heart: Cultivating Loving-Kindness, Compassion, Joy, and Equanimity
courses.description: A five-night stay at Kripalu built around the brahma-viharas, the four Buddhist heart meditations. Each day mixes guided sitting practice, breathwork and restful yoga with teaching on how these qualities can steady everyday life.

courses.title: Ayurveda for Meditators: Audio Course
courses.description: Ten short audio lessons on how the elements, the three doshas and the seasons shape a sitting practice. Each lesson offers simple choices in food, routine and self-care to make meditation more comfortable and clear.

courses.title: Pranayama for Restoring Vitality: Audio Course
courses.description: A self-paced set of ten audio lessons of about fifteen minutes each, teaching classic yogic breathing step by step. It moves from simple three-part breath and ujjayi through alternate-nostril breathing to gentle breath retention.

courses.title: Mindfulness for Caregivers: Audio Course
courses.description: Ten brief audio sessions for anyone looking after someone else, whether family or patients. The practices are short enough to fit into a busy day and focus on rest, compassion and finding quiet inside.

courses.title: Introductory Jyotisha Reading Package
courses.description: Two one-hour sessions looking at your Vedic birth chart, including rising sign, moon sign, key planets and nakshatras. The reading is framed as self-understanding rather than prediction, and links the chart to your Ayurveda and yoga practice. A birth time is needed.

courses.title: Island Mindfulness Retreat: Bahamas
courses.description: Four days at the Sivananda Ashram on Paradise Island, with sitting and walking meditation, loving-kindness practice, journaling and shell mandalas made on the beach. Aimed at both new and experienced meditators.

free_resources.title: Bedtime Body Scan
free_resources.description: A 22-minute guided body scan for the end of the day, free on Insight Timer. You rest lying down while attention travels slowly through the body.

free_resources.title: Metta Meditation (Loving Kindness)
free_resources.description: A five-minute loving-kindness practice, free on Insight Timer, offering phrases of goodwill to yourself and then outward to others.

free_resources.title: Pitta Pranayama
free_resources.description: A 23-minute guided breathing session on Insight Timer using cooling techniques suited to pitta dosha and hot weather.

free_resources.title: Free audio practices and yoga classes
free_resources.description: Her resources page gathers free recordings of meditation and pranayama, dosha-based breath practices, short yoga class videos and podcast conversations on Ayurveda.

Her regular in-person teaching is at Kripalu in Stockbridge, MA; check the city.

She has an Insight Timer teacher profile (24.7k followers, four courses) but isn't in the Insight Timer faculty files or linked to it on Spiritpedia, so insight-timer was not added to teaches_at; the owner may want it.
